_help: Your policy knobs. Every threshold needs a one-sentence 'why' (you'll be asked in the demo). evaluate.py warns while any 'why' still says TODO.
on_ezio_failure_why: Without the mock's public-claim check, an email needs human review; independent company-data contradictions still block.
tier_decisions_why: A GREEN tier alone never overrides a factual contradiction; YELLOW and RED require review unless a verified contradiction requires BLOCK.

tone.why: Below 65, promotional or hostile tone is unsuitable for customer email and merits review.

bias.why: Below 55, framing is one-sided enough that a lead should review it.

agreement.why: Below 55, unsupported agreement with a customer needs review.

when_accuracy_not_scored_why: No extracted claims is normal for routine email; independent company-data checks still run.
when_accuracy_unavailable_why: Unverified public claims need human review while company-data contradictions independently block.
